title: tests that run basic-auth through _run_server must set the secret key
answers: basic-auth server test fails with secret key error
how to test _run_server with app_name basic-auth
body:
Convention: tests in tests/server/test_init.py that call server._run_server with app_name="basic-auth" must set MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY with monkeypatch.setenv.
Reason: the pre-flight in mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth now raises before the mocked mlflow.server.auth.bootstrap_admin_user is reached, so the test fails for the wrong reason.
To test the missing-key path, use monkeypatch.delenv with raising=False and assert bootstrap is not called and exec_cmd is not called.
applies: Tests of basic-auth startup in tests/server/test_init.py.
says: The tracking server fails to start with basic authentication when secret keys are missing.
Require an encryption secret key before launching the server with basic authentication.
Basic authentication server startup crashes during preflight checks before creating admin accounts.
search: Tests running basic-auth through server._run_server in tests/server/test_init.py must set MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY using monkeypatch.setenv. The pre-flight check in mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth raises when the secret key is missing before reaching mocked bootstrap_admin_user. To test the missing-key path, use monkeypatch.delenv with raising=False and assert that bootstrap and exec_cmd are not called.
